case_title: CALVIN CHIN VS. BEST BUY CO.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY CHIN, CALVIN AS TO DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-06-2020 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL (AGENT FOR SERVICE OF PROCESS: CT CORPORATION SYSTEM[C0168406]) FILED BY PLAINTIFF CHIN, CALVIN AS TO DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AUG-11-2020, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.) FILED BY DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-06-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-06-2020 BY PANG LY. PLAINTIFF CALVIN CHIN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT BEST BUY COMPANY IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY WILLIAM REYES, OPS LEADERSHIP FOR SAN BRUNO LOCATION. PARTIES HAVE UNTIL NOV-20-2020 TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE OF CURRENT CONDITION OF THE REFRIGERATOR IN QUESTION. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SUPPLEMENTAL EXHIBITS RECEIVED BUT NOT FILED. (PARTIES HAVE UNTIL NOV-20-2020 TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE OF CURRENT CONDITION OF THE REFRIGERATOR IN QUESTION.) AS TO PLAINTIFF CHIN, CALVIN
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-06-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CHIN, CALVIN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO. $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $65.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,065.00, PLAINTIFF PRESENTED EVIDENCE ESTABLISHING THAT THE REFRIGERATOR IS FAILING TO MAINTAIN PROPER TEMPERATURE. DEFENDANT HAD OPPORTUNITY TO TEST AND FIX THE REFRIGERATOR AND FAILED TO PERFORM EITHER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS RECEIVED NOVEMBER 24, 2020 VIA UPS EXPRESS FILED BY DEFENDANT BEST BUY CO.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2021 ORDERED DESTROYED
